mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Harriet Park with an air quality index of 59 and a new moon in the night sky.

The City of Verona has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range roadmap focuses on creating stronger neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, and enhancing our natural assets.

There is a busy day ahead in our community. Today, you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to Century School Park for the Puppets in the Park event.

In a recent report covering the period of September 28 to October 5, officers investigated a noteworthy incident on October 3 where a 19-year-old man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a tip from the Cottage Grove Police Department.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed, but it will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
